name: Deployment Access
description: Credentials and configuration to deploy this instance — the OAuth client id/secret and cookie secret that deploy/.env holds. Probed by CONFIGURATION rather than by attempting a deployment, the same reading signing-api takes: a probe that tried to deploy would be indistinguishable from an outage, and would act on an external host just to answer a question about setup. The path is not invented — deploy/deploy.sh gates on exactly this file ([ ! -f "$DEPLOY_DIR/.env" ]) before it will run, so the probe agrees with the script it describes. Declared 2026-09-20, bean folio-assistant-q6ud: it was referenced by deployment-auth and declared by nothing, which executing the degradation model found on its first run.
